The connection between the tire and the wheel hub is indistinct. The tire sidewall seems to blend into the rim without a clear boundary, suggesting minor geometric melting or rendering error.
The vertical pillars supporting the roof show slight inconsistency in thickness and alignment relative to the chassis, appearing slightly warped rather than perfectly straight rigid tubes.
